unify_header.title: SVP Engineering, Agentic AI Platforms
unify_header.role_narrative: Led the platform roadmap, core systems architecture, and commercialization of a production-grade generative AI Solution Accelerator within a consulting firm, serving Fortune 500 financial institutions and converting bespoke client delivery into reusable IP deployed across enterprise lines of business.

companion_unify_bullets_context.text:
- bul_unify_001: Architected a governed agentic systems architecture establishing a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows across regulated financial-services engagements.
- bul_unify_002: Built consumption and renewal signal instrumentation for enterprise AI platform adoption, aligning adoption motions to partner revenue and deal-support priorities.
- bul_unify_003: Delivered audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows through context engineering and runtime resilience controls spanning evaluation gates and rollback paths.
- bul_unify_004: Standardized managed workflow orchestration and replayable runtime design, compressing the AI systems lifecycle from six months to three weeks for production deployments.
- bul_unify_005: Engineered high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms, integrating AWS and Databricks Lakehouse data pipelines with dense sparse exact retrieval design.
- bul_unify_006: Converted bespoke delivery into commercialized platform IP while scaling the engineering team from 8 to 28.

narrative_sentence: Owned Unify Consulting’s mandate to industrialize an agentic AI roadmap for regulated enterprise adoption, uniting control-plane architecture, cloud and data foundations, lifecycle governance, and alliance distribution into a productized operating model that transformed client-specific engineering into repeatable intellectual property and extensible platform offerings.
